Lemma
[Second-order chain rule along a linear form]

\group Wave Equation

Let $E$ be a normed real vector space, $\varphi \in C^2(\R )$, and $L:E\to \R $ a continuous linear form. For $p,v,w\in E$, \[ D^2(\varphi \circ L)(p)(v,w)=\varphi ''(Lp)(Lv)(Lw). \]
Proof

\sketch Apply the chain rule twice, using that the derivative of $L$ is $L$.

□
